extra_vocab.en: still left after other things have been used, done, or taken
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡放在名詞前面（the remaining materials），指「還沒出貨、還留在供應商那裡的其餘材料」。語感是「總量中尚未處理的那一部分」，常搭配 the 使用。

example.en: We hope sales will remain strong through the holiday season.
example.zh: 我們希望銷售在整個假期期間都能維持強勁。

example.en: Only one issue remains before we can sign the agreement.
example.zh: 在我們簽署協議之前，只剩一個問題要解決。

example.en: Two boxes remained in the warehouse after the shipment left.
example.zh: 貨物出貨後，倉庫裡還剩下兩個箱子。

example.en: Remaining calm helps our agents handle angry customers well.
example.zh: 保持冷靜能幫助我們的客服人員妥善處理憤怒的顧客。

example.en: The remainder of the order will arrive on Monday morning.
example.zh: 訂單的其餘部分會在週一早上送達。

example.en: Please check the remaining items before we close the order.
example.zh: 在我們結案之前，請檢查其餘的品項。

example.en: The remaining balance is due by the end of the month.
example.zh: 剩餘款項須在月底前付清。

example.en: We will sell the remaining stock at a lower price.
example.zh: 我們會以較低價格出售剩餘庫存。

examples.en: We will send the remaining documents tomorrow morning.
examples.zh: 我們明天早上會寄出其餘的文件。

examples.en: The remaining time will be used for questions.
examples.zh: 剩下的時間會用來回答問題。

examples.en: Only two remaining units are available in the warehouse.
examples.zh: 倉庫裡只剩下兩個庫存品可用。

examples.en: Three seats remain open for the training session.
examples.zh: 訓練課程還剩三個空位。

confusable.diff: the rest 是名詞，後面常接 of（the rest of the materials）；remaining 是形容詞，直接放在名詞前（the remaining materials）。

example.en: We will ship the rest of the materials on Monday.
example.zh: 我們會在週一寄出其餘的材料。

confusable.diff: left 較口語，常放在名詞後（two days left）；remaining 較正式，常用在商務書信。

example.en: We only have two days left before the deadline.
example.zh: 距離截止日我們只剩兩天了。

example.en: Some tasks remain unfinished at the end of the day.
example.zh: 到一天結束時，有些工作仍未完成。

example.en: We will deliver the remainder next week.
example.zh: 我們下週會交付剩下的部分。

derived.link: remain（剩下）+ -der，變成名詞「剩下的那一部分」，意思接近 the rest

example.en: The remaining funds will be used for staff training.
example.zh: 剩下的經費將用於員工訓練。

example.en: All prices remain the same until the end of June.
example.zh: 所有價格到六月底前維持不變。

senses.en: still left after other things have been used, done, or taken

example.en: Please pay the remaining amount before the delivery date.
example.zh: 請在交貨日前付清其餘的金額。

senses.en: to stay in the same state or condition
senses.distinguish: 後面接形容詞或過去分詞，如 remain open、remain seated。

example.en: Please remain seated until the presentation is over.
example.zh: 簡報結束前請保持坐著。

senses.en: to be left after other parts are gone or finished
senses.distinguish: 主詞是剩下的東西或工作，如 Only three tasks remain。

example.en: Only three tasks remain on the project schedule.
example.zh: 專案時程表上只剩下三項工作。

senses.en: to stay in a place and not leave
senses.distinguish: 後面接地點，如 remain in the lobby。

example.en: Visitors must remain in the lobby until a guide arrives.
example.zh: 訪客必須待在大廳，直到嚮導到來。
